==== Shortcuts ====
{| class="valign-top" style="min-width: 80em"
|

{|
| style="min-width: 15em" | {{Controls|Ctrl|N}}
| New file
|-
| {{Controls|Ctrl|O}} / {{Controls|Ctrl|L}}
| Open file
|-
| {{Controls|Ctrl|S}}
| Save the current file
|-
| {{Controls|Ctrl|E}}
| Save the current file as EMF
|-
| {{Controls|Ctrl|D}}
| Duplicate the selection
|-
| {{Controls|Ctrl|G}}
| Group or ungroup the selection
|-
| {{Controls|Ctrl|PageUp}}
| Bring the current node to the front
|-
| {{Controls|Ctrl|PageDown}}
| Bring the current node to the back
|}

|

{|
| style="min-width: 15em" | {{Controls|Shift|F3}}
| Find previous occurrence
|-
| {{Controls|Ctrl|F3}}
| Find next occurrence
|-
| {{Controls|Ctrl|A}}
| Select all
|-
| {{Controls|F1}}
| Insert mode
|-
| {{Controls|Ctrl|F2}}
| Design mode
|-
| {{Controls|Ctrl|F3}}
| Link mode
|-
| {{Controls|Ctrl|F4}}
| (over a link) Change the shape of the link
|-
| {{Controls|Ctrl|F8}}
| Reset zoom
|-
| {{Controls|Ctrl|C}}
| Change color
|-
| {{Controls|Ctrl|K}}
| (over a link) Reproduce last link's customisation
|}

|}
